prompt.alinti: Most people don't realize that you can use JEV to build a 24-7 high-frequency trading system that makes trading decisions in under 100 milliseconds while normal LLMs take 3-10 seconds.
Here's how you set it up in three steps.
Step 1. Connect your live exchange speed.
Instead of dumping raw charts into AI, your code summarizes buyer demand, order that then price data into a tiny data snapshot.
2. Send that snapshot over to JEV using the TypeSafe SDK.
JEV then evaluates multiple type questions in parallel, flagging whether incoming market flow is informed or noise.
Your code then computes your reservation speed using the Alvanita story call formula, verifies account limits, and automatically cancels your post limit orders.
The best part is JEV is trained with RLCD instead of human preference. This means that higher confidence scores actually correlate with real market probability.
I put together a detailed substantive guide with prompts, tools, and GitHub resources in order to build this out.
If you want it, just like the video and comment HFT and I'll send it to you.
